chapter: Later tours, illness and the union job
title: Working at the musicians' union in 1972
summary: His union job in 1972 keeps him among friends instead of idle on Long Island.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: Well, you haven't sort of severed connections with music because you've been working this year of 1972 for the musicians' union.

Right, right. No at the union you see, I'm around all my friends and it keeps me from bugging myself like as I said, in Long Island doing nothing day after day. Nothing at all but watching television, drinking at the bar or working in the yard.
At the union, every day I see somebody. A lot of people in fact, they all come by to see me,
You're tucked away in a corner, but they know where to find you.
Oh yes, they know where I'm at. They know where I am.
Yes, so at least there's an interest there which there wouldn't be in any other 9 - 5 job like our friends who've taken jobs in Wall Street.
I mean that's something to do.
